summary: Regression test of the AdminDashboard refactor (1225-line monolith → 1 shell + 12 sub-components under /pages/admin/). Frontend-only smoke test as requested. Logged in as zwatson, dashboard rendered without crash, spinner cleared. All refactor-preserved data-testids resolved: admin-manage-blog-btn, -subscribers-btn, -testimonies-btn, -lybtl-btn, admin-impact-card + edit/save + all 3 numeric inputs (lives_touched/kits_given/miracle_runs), admin-goal-card + edit/input/save, all 6 admin-tab-<key> (donations, volunteers, contacts, prayers, notary, resources), admin-resources-panel, resource-filter (showed 'All categories (48)' + per-category counts identical to iteration_4), add-resource-btn, resource-modal, resource-modal-save, all 10 resource-field-* (category, sort-order, name, description, address, phone, website, hours, notes, active), and dynamic resource-edit-<id>/-toggle-<id>/-delete-<id>. Full resource CRUD verified end-to-end: create 'Refactor Smoke Test' → row appeared → edit renamed → toggle showed 'Hidden' badge → delete removed row. Impact editor Edit→Cancel correctly reverts view. Tab bar clicked through all 6 tabs with no crashes. Donations tab renders Apply Filters + Export CSV buttons. Manage Notes button navigated to /admin/blog and back. Refactor = ZERO regressions in interactive behavior or testid coverage.

minor.issue: 404 in preview when clicking 'Save' on Impact Editor. Refactor-neutral (endpoint was likely absent in preview before too); UI is correct — surfaces toast.error via handleSaveImpact catch. Pre-existing preview backend gap.
404 in preview when clicking Goal 'Save'. Same as above — updateMonthlyGoal fails in preview backend; refactor UI is correct.
404 in preview. Already caught silently via .catch(() => null) in fetchAllData — TodayCard just renders empty. Non-blocking.
404 in preview when navigating to /admin/blog. Unrelated to refactor — belongs to Blog admin page, not AdminDashboard.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Preview backend is missing PUT /api/admin/impact-stats and monthly-goal update endpoints — Impact 'Save' and Goal 'Save' show 'Failed to update' toast in preview. Refactor is fine; production Cloudflare backend presumably has these. Consider stubbing them in preview server.py for parity so admin smoke tests pass end-to-end.

OPTIONAL: Console shows React hydration validation warnings ('<span> cannot be a child of <select>/<option>' and '<tr> cannot be a child of <span>'). These are DOM-level warnings — no matching pattern was found in the refactored admin/*.jsx files (DonationsTab tables and ResourcesTab select are clean). Likely injected by a browser extension (Google Translate) or a global Header/Footer component in App.js. Not caused by this refactor. If we want a fully clean console, main agent could audit any component in App.js/Header for stray <span> wrappers around tables or select elements.
critical_code_review_comments: Refactor is clean: AdminDashboard.jsx shrank to 429 lines with clear separation — state + fetch + handlers in the shell, presentation in /pages/admin/*.jsx. Prop drilling is explicit but reasonable given the small component tree.
GoalEditor.jsx handleCancel resets goalInput to progress.goal — good.
ImpactEditor.jsx correctly returns null when impact is undefined, so a 404 on GET /impact-stats doesn't render broken UI.
ResourceModal.jsx: labels use `htmlFor={testId}` but input `data-testid` (not `id`) — the htmlFor doesn't actually link to an input `id`. Cosmetic accessibility miss, non-blocking.

AdminDashboard.jsx line 103: useEffect has empty deps `[]` but ESLint would flag missing `navigate` in deps. React-Router's navigate is stable so no bug, but consider `// eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps`.
handleSaveResource still mutates local resources[] optimistically without refetch — carried over from pre-refactor code (also noted in iteration_4). Acceptable.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for refactor scope — every listed data-testid present and every listed interaction working. 2 backend endpoints (impact save, goal save) 404 in preview which surface as expected error toasts, but that's a preview-backend gap not a refactor regression.

seed_data_creation: Created 'Refactor Smoke Test' resource during test → deleted in same run. Backend seed left at 48 resources (verified via filter dropdown showing 'All categories (48)' at start and no residual custom rows after delete).
